concepts.name: review
concepts.definition: What the hive derives as needing attention now, served at /api/review and decoded by MnemionKit's Review: due review hooks, overdue, due and stalled work, alignment gaps; also one entry a hook records in the reviews pattern, linked commits-to the work or reflects-on the start review.

concepts.name: mnemion
concepts.definition: The hive this app is a client of: the Cloudflare Worker that is the single source of truth, reached over /api/* and /ws with the signed-in member's bearer; also the product's name, carried by the app, its share extension and the Kit.

concepts.name: app intent
concepts.definition: A type conforming to AppIntent whose perform Siri, Shortcuts, Spotlight or the Action button run with the signed-in session; CaptureNoteIntent is the one this app offers, listed by MnemionShortcuts.
